findings.title: traceID no longer included in log output
findings.body: The previous implementation explicitly extracted the trace ID via `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and appended it to `logParams`. This has been removed, and the new `ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext` does not include the trace ID in the contextual attributes it sets on the context. Unless the infra log layer's `FromContext` implementation independently extracts the trace ID from the span context (which is not guaranteed by the code shown), log messages will no longer contain the `traceID` field. This is a silent observability regression that could break log-based dashboards, alerts, or trace-to-log correlation.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards all contextual state
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns a brand-new `NewTestLogger()` with no connection to the context or the original logger. This makes it impossible to write meaningful tests that verify the `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` is properly enriching the logger via context. Any test calling `FromContext` will get a logger with zero recorded calls, regardless of what was set in the context. Consider returning `f` itself (or a copy that records which context it was called with) so tests can assert on contextual propagation.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger interface is a breaking change
findings.body: The `Logger` interface in `pkg/plugins/log` gains a new required method `FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger`. Any external or internal code that implements this interface (outside of the two implementations updated here) will fail to compile. Since this package is under `pkg/` and may be imported by plugins or other Grafana modules, this is a breaking API change that should be called out in the PR description or changelog.

findings.title: Stream operations not enriched with contextual logger
findings.body: `SubscribeStream`, `PublishStream`, and `RunStream` do not call `instrumentContext`, so the context passed downstream for stream operations will lack the plugin ID, endpoint, data source, and user attributes. If any downstream middleware or the plugin SDK itself uses `FromContext` for logging during stream operations, those log lines will be missing contextual information. This is inconsistent with the other four operations and may lead to confusing or incomplete logs for streaming plugins.
